Otherwise you'll have to backtrack through the dungeons to go back outside. * Master level spells, such as [[Skyrim:Fire Storm|Fire Storm]] and [[Skyrim:Guardian Circle|Guardian Circle]], may be prepared while ethereal. * The [[Skyrim:Bloodskal Blade|Bloodskal Blade]]'s{{DB}} special ability can be used while ethereal. * The first level of this shout is long enough to last through a dragon's breath attack, should taking cover or avoiding it not be an option. '''Call Dragon''' is a [[Skyrim:Dragon Shouts|dragon shout]] that summons [[Skyrim:Odahviing|Odahviing]] to fight alongside you, but only if it is used outdoors. After shouting all three words, there will be a short delay, then Odahviing will arrive at your location. Odahviing is essential, and will not leave your vicinity until you are out of combat, making this shout particularly useful for difficult fights. All three words of this shout are learned during [[Skyrim:The Fallen|The Fallen]], after which Odahviing will not respond again to this shout until the [[Skyrim:Main Quest|main quest]] is complete.

'''Call of Valor''' is a [[Skyrim:Dragon Shouts|dragon shout]] that summons a hero to fight alongside you. [[Skyrim:Tsun|Tsun]] teaches this shout to you at the end of [[Skyrim:Dragonslayer|Dragonslayer]], the conclusion of the [[Skyrim:Main Quest|main quest]].

Using one word summons [[Skyrim:Gormlaith Golden-Hilt|Gormlaith Golden-Hilt]], two words summons [[Skyrim:Felldir the Old|Felldir the Old]], and three words summons [[Skyrim:Hakon One-Eye|Hakon One-Eye]]. 

{{NewLeft}}
== Related Quests ==
* {{Quest Link|Dragonslayer}}

== Notes ==
* If Call of Valor is used while a conjured creature is still active, the shout will dispel the creature and replace it with the summoned hero. The reverse can happen as well; if a summoned hero is active, a [[Skyrim:Conjure|Conjure]] spell will dispel the hero and replace it with the conjured creature. This even applies to summoning [[Skyrim:Durnehviir|Durnehviir]], as well, as he is considered a summoned creature: calling for Durnehviir's help will dispel the heroes of Sovngarde, and summoning a hero of Sovngarde will dispel Durnehviir.

'''Dragonrend''' is a [[Skyrim:Dragon Shouts|dragon shout]] that weakens a [[Skyrim:Dragon|dragon]] and forces it to land. It is said to do so by forcing a dragon to experience mortality, a completely foreign concept to the ageless and immortal dragons. For this very reason, it is impossible for any dragon to learn Dragonrend. 

The shout is learned during [[Skyrim:Alduin's Bane|Alduin's Bane]], as part of the [[Skyrim:Main Quest|main quest]], by hearing the three Nordic heroes, [[Skyrim:Gormlaith Golden-Hilt|Gormlaith Golden-Hilt]], [[Skyrim:Felldir the Old|Felldir the Old]], and [[Skyrim:Hakon One-Eye|Hakon One-Eye]], use it against [[Skyrim:Alduin|Alduin]].

At full strength, it casts [[Skyrim:Soul Trap (effect)|soul trap]] upon foes, drains their health for 300 points on impact, and if the target is below level 100 and dies within 2 seconds, it captures their soul and [[Skyrim:Reanimate|resurrects]] the corpse to fight for you for 1 minute.

* {{achievement|Soul Tear (achievement)|descr=no}}

'''Summon Durnehviir''' is a [[Skyrim:Dragon Shouts|dragon shout]] that summons [[Skyrim:Durnehviir (dragon)|Durnehviir]], an undead dragon, from the [[Skyrim:Soul Cairn|Soul Cairn]]. Unlike the [[Skyrim:Call Dragon|Call Dragon]] shout, the Summon Durnehviir shout works like a Conjuration spell. You have to aim it at the ground and have enough space around the point of summoning for the shout to succeed. This also means that you can summon him within certain enclosed areas such as caves as long as there is enough room. The first three times he is summoned, he will teach you a word for the [[Skyrim:Soul Tear|Soul Tear]] shout. After the third time, he will only mention how excited he is to be free of the Soul Cairn.

When not in combat, he flies overhead. In combat, he uses Frost Breath, Drain Vitality, and a [[Skyrim:Soul_Cairn_Summon|unique shout]] that summons a [[Skyrim:Boneman|Boneman]], a [[Skyrim:Mistman|Mistman]], and a [[Skyrim:Wrathman|Wrathman]] from the Soul Cairn to attack the target. He will follow you from above and will land only to engage enemies. In small spaces, he may land or never take off.

First summon: ''"Ah! The free air of Vus at long last! As promised, I now teach you the first word of Soul Tearing: "Rii" - the essence of your enemy's life force."''

Second summon: ''"I can feel my strength returning each time I am set free from that prison! Hear now the second word of Soul Tearing: "Vaaz" - meaning to tear your enemy's soul from its living vessel."''

Third summon: ''"You have kept your side of the bargain, now let me fulfill mine. Feel the last word of Soul Tearing within yourself: "Zol" - the unlife that results when a soul is imprisoned in dead flesh."''

After learning all words: ''"The skies of Keizaal are mine again!"'' or ''"You give me freedom from the enslavement of the Ideal Masters. Thank you."'' or ''"I rejoice in my freedom, if only for a moment."''

If the damage taken from the shout kills the enemy, their body is replaced by an ash pile. Combined with the aforementioned ability Force without Effort, this makes Unrelenting Force one of the most devastating shouts in-game, especially against weak enemies that are standing on cliffs, mountains or other high areas where they will sustain fall damage, or it is also incredibly useful within dungeons. == Related Quests == * {{Quest Link|The Golden Claw}} * {{Quest Link|Bleak Falls Barrow (quest)}} * {{Quest Link|The Way of the Voice}} * {{Quest Link|The Horn of Jurgen Windcaller}} == Possible Uses == * Unrelenting Force can be useful when fighting an enemy who can be pushed off a high location: [[Skyrim:Combat#Falling Damage|falling]] damages and kills NPCs easier than it does you. * Use this shout at low power to momentarily stun a foe, opening up their defenses for an attack. * Use the shout to open [[Skyrim:Draugr|draugr]] tombs that lie on the ground in dungeons (though not those propped against walls). * Use it to detonate rune traps and tripwires from a safe distance. * If you use the shout against fish in water, they will die and float on the water, allowing you to collect them. It won't work on [[Skyrim:Slaughterfish|Slaughterfish]], though. ** You can use it on salmon as a way to collect [[Skyrim:Salmon Meat|salmon meat]] and [[Skyrim:Salmon Roe|Salmon Roe]]{{HF}}. * The shout will also kill insects in the air, dropping their remains to the ground where they can be collected for use in alchemy. ==Notes== * Fall damage is not applied to the victim until a few seconds after the target has come to a complete stop, right before they start getting back up. To distinguish this ragdoll from real death, look for the pulsing red hue on your screen; if it is not there, you are still alive. If it is there, either you are close to death or have already died. For death, the game will abruptly cut music and replace it with a somber tone. It is also possible to jump during the animation of getting back up, even while your body is still in the prone position where it first landed. * Use caution when attacking enemies that use this shout while you are [[Skyrim:Dragon Riding|riding a dragon]]. As such, among other things, [[Skyrim:Ward|Ward]] spells (including the ward created by blocking with [[Skyrim:Spellbreaker|Spellbreaker]]) completely negate the effects of draugr's Unrelenting Force shout on you, preventing the ragdoll effect. *Draugr use two different types of this shout, though the words are still the same (easily seen when the general subtitles are turned on). It can be used even if you are [[Skyrim:Carry Weight|overencumbered]]. This shout carries you horizontally, so do not use it to go down slopes; you will find yourself in mid-air when the sprint ends. {{NewLeft}} == Related Quests == * {{Quest Link|Tending the Flames}} * {{Quest Link|The Horn of Jurgen Windcaller}} * {{Quest Link|The Way of the Voice}} * {{Quest Link|Volskygge (quest)}} == Possible Uses == * Charging a distant archer/mage. * Escaping a much stronger enemy. * Jumping to an area enemies cannot reach in order to hit them with ranged attacks without retaliation. * Escaping from various glitches that cause you to get stuck in the scenery. * Faster travel, particularly when overencumbered. * If you hold an object against any locked door or hidden path to another cell and use Whirlwind Sprint, you will jump into the holding space behind the door or path. There is no way back except by use of the console, or if the lock is actually pickable. This glitch is best used on doors blocking access through to the same cell, (i.e., no loading screens normally required). * If you hold a [[Skyrim:Wooden Plate|wooden plate]] or [[Skyrim:Platter|platter]] against a wall and use Whirlwind Sprint, you will make your way across. You can access [[Skyrim:Merchant Chest|merchant chests]] and [[Skyrim:Do Not Delete|Do Not Delete]] chests this way, depending on the wall. * Bypass floor [[Skyrim:Traps|traps]] and [[Skyrim:Traps#Triggers|triggers]], and avoid [[Skyrim:Swinging Blades|swinging blades]]. === Hidden Areas === There are many hidden areas that are only accessible via this shout (or the [[Skyrim:Vampire Lord|Vampire Lord's]] Bats power). This is only a list of places where valuable loot can be found. * [[Skyrim:Ansilvund|Ansilvund]]: Outside Ansilvund is a tower. From the rocks above the entrance to Ansilvund it is possible to jump to the top of the tower and access a high-leveled chest. * [[Skyrim:Ustengrav|Ustengrav]]: In Ustengrav Depths above the waterfall, there is a series of broken pillars that can be used to access a hidden room with a skeleton and some leveled potions. * [[Skyrim:Yngvild|Yngvild]]: Midway through the caves there is a large circular shaft with a central column; behind the column is a locked chest. * [[Skyrim:Nchuand-Zel|Nchuand-Zel]]: In the Nchuand-Zel Excavation Site, there is a large, egg-shaped room at the west end of the local map just before you encounter the first spider. In the northwest corner of this room, you can jump up onto a wooden structure, then climb up the rocks sticking out of the wall. Once at the top, use Whirlwind Sprint to cross over to the crippled stonework ledge for a small unlocked chest. * [[Skyrim:Shroud Hearth Barrow|Shroud Hearth Barrow]]: In the last area in Shroud Hearth Depths, to the left of the word wall, there is a collapsed bridge that leads to several items. * [[Skyrim:Reachwater Rock|Reachwater Rock]]: There is a chest on the ledge of the main chamber opposite the entrance to the crypt. * [[Skyrim:Shadowgreen Cavern|Shadowgreen Cavern]]: There is a boss level chest on the far side of the chasm, accessible with a level 3 whirlwind Sprint. ==Notes== * The two-word version of this shout gives you the highest amount of distance traveled per second of recharge time. To elaborate, the one-word version allows you to travel 2.5 feet per second of recharge, the two-word version grants the best distance of 3 feet per second of recharge, while the three-word version provides a slightly shorter distance of 2.85 feet per second of recharge. * While there are three [[Skyrim:Word Wall|word wall]] texts for this shout, only two of them will appear in any single game; the [[Skyrim:Greybeards|Greybeards]] will teach you one of the words. * If used while swimming, upon exiting the water, or jumping, as with all shouts, Whirlwind Sprint will immediately activate. This allows for a quick boost should you jump out of water, sending you the normal distance in whatever direction you are facing when you exit the water. ** This also may cause undesired effects if you unintentionally use it and exit the water.
